name: Matthew Carter
source:
Matthew Carter is Ace's best friend and fellow freshman at Olympus University. He and Ace have known each other well before attending college together, and he's one of the reasons Ace ended up at Olympus in the first place! Matt is also a dedicated member of the track and field team, and usually does his best to encourage Ace to find a place where he can belong to.
